svg.title: Stock Market Dashboard Tech Stack Plan
svg.desc: Architecture diagram showing the full Python-based tech stack for a real-time stock market dashboard, from data source through backend to frontend.

g.text: Real-time NSE / BSE quotes, OHLCV, 52-week high/low, screener data
REST endpoints · WebSocket push · Watchlist CRUD · Background scheduler (APScheduler)
1D–5D · 1W–5W · 1M–12M · YoY · 1Y–5Y price change & % change · color indicators
Trading-day detection · Holiday lookup · Open/Closed notification on startup

svg.text: Python tech stack · tradingview-screener 3.2.0 as data source
